evidence_items.explanation: The figures show substantial concentration in general cloud infrastructure services. They do not measure AI data-center capacity, Meta's infrastructure, or access to specialized GPUs.

CoreWeave reported a substantial operating footprint as a specialized GPU-cloud supplier. This challenges an exclusive-control reading, but the disclosure does not establish its market share or how much capacity was independently available.

Oracle reported existing AI customers outside the four named infrastructure suppliers. The announced OpenAI capacity extension involved Microsoft, so this does not establish independence of every workload or disprove collective market power.

unresolved_gaps: No matching worldwide denominator for AI-capable data-center capacity.
No comprehensive allocation of specialized GPU ownership and contracted access among the four firms and independent suppliers.
Independent suppliers' existence does not establish the absence of effective collective control.
General cloud revenue concentration does not establish the claimed AI infrastructure monopoly.
